import sys
import bisect

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    T = int(next(it))
    a.sort()
    ans = 0
    for i in range(n):
        p = bisect.bisect_right(a, a[i] + T, i, n)
        ans = max(ans, p - i)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
